hero.title: A cocoa house, from Bahia to Aveiro.
hero.lead: Amêndoa D'Cacau is a Brazilian rustic-chocolate house. We grow the cocoa and take the fruit to the bar — tree-to-bar — with Europe served from Aveiro.

portrait.alt: Amêndoa D'Cacau seal, integral natural, since 1890

timeline.title: Great-great-grandfather and the fruit
timeline.text: The family has been in cocoa since the nineteenth century. Our great-great-grandfather was already working the crop in southern Bahia; the packaging still reads since 1890.

timeline.title: The farm stayed in the family
timeline.text: Children and grandchildren kept the land. Cocoa here was never a branding hobby: it is the craft that runs through the house.

timeline.title: This generation
timeline.text: For more than fifteen years our father has run Fazenda Eustáquio. Planting, harvest, fermentation, drying, selection and making — control stays in the family.

timeline.title: European base
timeline.text: Portugal is the foothold in Europe. Aveiro holds the bean stock for chocolate makers on this side of the Atlantic.
